def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):

import itertools
# cases: per box: geometry, fill-color dots (r,c), K, kept/absorbed info
# d1: 3s->box8, 6s->box4 ; d2: 8s->box2, 4s->box3
def feats(case):
    col_,r1,r2,c1,c2 = case['geom']; ds = case['dots']; K = case['K']
    other = case['other']
    ih, iw = r2-r1-1, c2-c1-1
    checker = (ih*iw + 1)//2
    n = len(ds)
    def cnt(pred): return sum(1 for r,c in ds if pred(r,c))
    f = {
      'n': n, 'checker': checker, 'ih': ih, 'iw': iw, 'h': r2-r1+1, 'w': c2-c1+1,
      'above': cnt(lambda r,c: r<r1), 'below': cnt(lambda r,c: r>r2), 'span': cnt(lambda r,c: r1<=r<=r2),
      'incol': cnt(lambda r,c: c1<=c<=c2),
      'above_incol': cnt(lambda r,c: r<r1 and c1<=c<=c2), 'above_outcol': cnt(lambda r,c: r<r1 and not(c1<=c<=c2)),
      'below_incol': cnt(lambda r,c: r>r2 and c1<=c<=c2), 'below_outcol': cnt(lambda r,c: r>r2 and not(c1<=c<=c2)),
      'span_incol': cnt(lambda r,c: r1<=r<=r2 and c1<=c<=c2), 'span_outcol': cnt(lambda r,c: r1<=r<=r2 and not(c1<=c<=c2)),
      'le_bot1': cnt(lambda r,c: r<=r2-1), 'le_bot2': cnt(lambda r,c: r<=r2-2), 'le_bot3': cnt(lambda r,c: r<=r2-3),
      'lt_other_bot': cnt(lambda r,c: r<other[1]), 'lt_other_top': cnt(lambda r,c: r<other[0]),
      'le_other_bot': cnt(lambda r,c: r<=other[1]),
      'above_mid': cnt(lambda r,c: r < (r1+r2)/2), 'le_mid': cnt(lambda r,c: r <= (r1+r2)//2),
      'n_half_below': cnt(lambda r,c: r > (r1+r2)/2),
      'H': case['H'], 'W': case['W'],
      'K': K, 'absorbed': case['absorbed'],
    }
    return f
cases = []
d1g = {8:(8,1,4,1,7), 4:(4,6,13,14,20)}
d2g = {2:(2,1,5,2,6), 3:(3,10,13,9,17)}

def dotfeatures(allboxes, r, c, H, W):
    f = {}
    f['r']=r; f['c']=c; f['H']=H; f['W']=W; f['Hmr']=H-r; f['Wmc']=W-c
    for i,(col_,t,b,l,rt) in enumerate(allboxes):
        h=b-t+1; w=rt-l+1; ih=h-2; iw=w-2
        fb = t + (h+1)//2   # fill bottom row
        f[f'b{i}_above']=r<t; f[f'b{i}_below']=r>b; f[f'b{i}_span']=t<=r<=b
        f[f'b{i}_incol']=l<=c<=rt
        f[f'b{i}_drow']= 0 if t<=r<=b else min(abs(r-t),abs(r-b))
        f[f'b{i}_dcol']= 0 if l<=c<=rt else min(abs(c-l),abs(c-rt))
        f[f'b{i}_manh']=f[f'b{i}_drow']+f[f'b{i}_dcol']
        f[f'b{i}_cheb']=max(f[f'b{i}_drow'],f[f'b{i}_dcol'])
        f[f'b{i}_below_dist']=r-b
        f[f'b{i}_above_dist']=t-r
        f[f'b{i}_r_above_fb']=r<=fb; f[f'b{i}_r_le_bot']=r<=b
        f[f'b{i}_ih']=ih; f[f'b{i}_h']=h; f[f'b{i}_fb']=fb
    # cross features
    (c1_,t1,b1,l1,r1_),(c2_,t2,b2,l2,r2_) = allboxes[0], allboxes[1]
    f['between_rows']= (min(t1,b1) <= r <= max(b1,t1)) or (min(t2,b2) <= r <= max(b2,t2))
    f['below_both']= r>max(b1,b2); f['above_both']= r<min(t1,t2)
    f['incol_any']= f['b0_incol'] or f['b1_incol']
    f['max_below_dist']= max(r-b1, r-b2)
    f['min_pos_below']= min(x for x in [r-b1 if r>b1 else 99, r-b2 if r>b2 else 99])
    return f

    for (bc, t, b, l, r) in bs:

    dts = []
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v and not any(t<=i<=b and l<=j<=r for (bc,t,b,l,r) in bs):

import math, json
from collections import Counter
tb = boxes(test); td = dots_of(test, tb)
fb_max = max(t + math.ceil((b-t+1)/2) for (bc,t,b,l,r) in tb)

                out3[rr][cc] = pairs[bc]

print(json.dumps({"action": "submit", "grid": out3}))

def dump(name, gin, gout):
    print("=====", name, f"{len(gin)}x{len(gin[0])}")
    bxs = boxes(gin)
    print("boxes:", bxs)
    din = dots_of(gin, bxs)
    # dots in output: nonzero cells not part of box borders or fills
    print("in-dots:", sorted((r,c,v) for r,c,v in din))
    # output nonzero outside boxes
    bset = set()
    for (bc,t,b,l,r) in bxs:
        for rr in range(t,b+1):
            for cc in range(l,r+1): bset.add((rr,cc))
    outcells = sorted((r,c,gout[r][c]) for r in range(len(gout)) for c in range(len(gout[0])) if gout[r][c] and (r,c) not in bset)
    print("out-extra:", outcells)
